shared_elements: small anthropomorphic figure with raised/bent arms
horizontal band or ridge running along the upper edge
repeated figures arranged in a row
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing shallow relief with a row of repeated animate figures set beneath a horizontal band or rim, and both include a small anthropomorph with arms bent upward beside quadrupeds. But A is a tall flat slab with several stacked registers of flat, linear, largely animal imagery read vertically, while B is a curved vessel wall carrying a single continuous horizontal frieze of bulging, rounded, strongly modelled humanoid bodies — a different format, rhythm and carving manner.
